scope: Focused evidence for the final three authoring workflow gate rows

evidence: Exact scene property paths position, eulerAngles, scale, and active are written with typed dumps.
A scene snapshot is requested after writes.
Fresh query-node read-back is required for every requested field and stale values fail with NODE_TRANSFORM_UPDATE_UNCONFIRMED.
Focused test proves the success response and the direct route metadata.
limitations: Only bounded position, Euler rotation, scale, and active fields are covered; arbitrary transform or lifecycle semantics are not inferred.
Rollback of a partially applied transform batch is not claimed by this route.

evidence: Project-wide asset-db enumeration produces graphVersion v4 evidence.
Serialized scene UUID references create graph edges; reachable and project-unreachable assets are distinguished.
Candidate and reference evidence are bounded by maxAssets/maxGraphAssets and the registered output schema caps candidates at 128.
The result exposes graph completeness, roots, truncation, exclusions, and the dynamic-load caveat.
Focused test proves a reachable scene dependency and an unreachable candidate.
limitations: Static graph proof covers serialized UUID references only; dynamic runtime addressables, resources.load, and computed string paths remain outside proof.
Completeness is false when the graph is truncated or serialized source files are excluded/unavailable.

evidence: Move preflights target existence, applies set-parent, snapshots, and requires authoritative parent read-back; mismatches fail with NODE_MOVE_UNCONFIRMED.
UI layout mutation captures original values, applies bounded fields, and aborts the pending snapshot on partial failure while restoring already-applied fields.
Focused test proves both a postcondition failure and rollback-safe partial mutation behavior.
limitations: This is bounded per-operation evidence, not a universal transaction spanning arbitrary scene mutations.
nodeOperate move reports postcondition failure but does not claim automatic parent rollback.
Only the tested uiLayoutApply partial-failure path claims rollback; other mutation families have their own contracts.

verification.fullSuite: not run; parent agent owns project-wide validation
